steps.title: Analyze character codings for species terminals
steps.instruction: Fig. 14. Results of iterative analyses testing the effect of assigning character codings from isolated elements to species terminals. Strict consensus of 2642 MPTs of 4494 steps from the analysis applying codings from IB/P/B-0382 (type B humerus) to the Delphinornis arctowskii terminal. An identical strict consensus topology, with some variation in number of MPTs, resulted from the permutations adding the type B humerus codings to the Delphinornis gracilis (1920 MPTs, 4494 steps), Delphinornis larseni (2170 MPTs, 4494 steps), and Delphinornis wimani (2832 trees, 4494 steps) terminals.

substeps.instruction: Test effect of assigning character codings from IB/P/B-0382 (type B humerus) to Delphinornis arctowskii terminal
Generate strict consensus of 2642 MPTs from 4494 steps
Add type B humerus codings to Delphinornis gracilis terminal and generate 1920 MPTs from 4494 steps
Add type B humerus codings to Delphinornis larseni terminal and generate 2170 MPTs from 4494 steps
Add type B humerus codings to Delphinornis wimani terminal and generate 2832 trees from 4494 steps
